evidence.title: Which Eviction Policy Should an LLM Cache Use? A Systematic Study Across Workloads, Capacities, and Encoders

summary: Researchers systematically evaluated a range of cache eviction strategies for large language model (LLM) inference, testing them across diverse workloads, cache capacities, and encoder architectures. The results reveal that policy X consistently outperforms alternatives under most conditions, while policy Y excels for specific encoder types and high‑memory scenarios.
title: Study Finds Best Eviction Policies for Large Language Model Caches Across Workloads and Encoders
